SELECT B.MENU_ID,B.ICON,B.NAME,B.TYPE,B.IS_DISPLAY,B.CREATE_TIME,B.PRIORITY,B.IMAGE_PATH,B.URL_TYPE FROM (select * from SYS_MENU B WHERE 1 = 1 and URL_TYPE != 'BUTTON'
AND B.DEL_FLAG = #{delFlag}
AND B.DEL_FLAG = 0
AND B.PARENT_ID = #{parentId}
AND (B.PARENT_ID IS NULL OR B.PARENT_ID = 0)
AND B.TYPE = #{type} AND B.APP_ID = #{appId}
and B.NAME like concat('%',concat(#{name},'%'))
and B.CREATE_TIME like concat('%',concat(#{createTime},'%'))
AND date_format(B.CREATE_TIME,'%Y-%m-%d') >= date_format(#{startTime},'%Y-%m-%d') AND date_format(B.CREATE_TIME,'%Y-%m-%d') <= date_format(#{endTime},'%Y-%m-%d')
AND date_format(B.CREATE_TIME,'%Y-%m-%d') >= date_format(#{startTime},'%Y-%m-%d') AND date_format(B.CREATE_TIME,'%Y-%m-%d') <= date_format(#{endTime},'%Y-%m-%d')
AND to_char(B.CREATE_TIME,'YYYY-MM-DD') >= to_char(#{startTime},'YYYY-MM-DD') AND to_char(B.CREATE_TIME,'YYYY-MM-DD') <= to_char(#{endTime},'YYYY-MM-DD')
AND B.IS_PROTECT = #{isProtect}
AND B.IS_PROTECT = 1
ORDER BY PRIORITY asc ) B

SELECT t2.MENU_ID AS id, t2.PARENT_ID as parentId, t2.NAME as name, 1 as checked FROM (SELECT rm.MENU_ID FROM SYS_ROLE_MENU rm, SYS_ROLE r WHERE rm.ROLE_ID = #{roleId} AND r.APP_ID = #{appId} AND r.ROLE_ID = rm.ROLE_ID) t1, (SELECT * FROM SYS_MENU t WHERE t.APP_ID = #{appId} AND DEL_FLAG = 0) t2 WHERE t1.MENU_ID = t2.MENU_ID UNION ALL SELECT t2.MENU_ID AS id, t2.PARENT_ID as parentId, t2.NAME as name, 0 as checked FROM SYS_MENU t2 WHERE t2.APP_ID = #{appId} AND DEL_FLAG = 0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM (SELECT rm.MENU_ID FROM SYS_ROLE_MENU rm, SYS_ROLE r WHERE rm.ROLE_ID = #{roleId} AND r.APP_ID = #{appId} AND r.ROLE_ID = rm.ROLE_ID) t1 WHERE t1.MENU_ID = t2.MENU_ID)
SELECT A.MENU_ID AS id, A.PARENT_ID, A.APP_ID, A.NAME, 0 AS checked FROM SYS_MENU A WHERE APP_ID IN ('EFRAME') AND DEL_FLAG = 0 AND TYPE != 'BUTTON' ORDER BY APP_ID, PARENT_ID, PRIORITY ASC
SELECT max(t.MENU_ID) as maxid FROM SYS_MENU t
mapper.sql: insert into SYS_MENU ( MENU_ID, PARENT_ID, APP_ID, NAME, SNAME, ENAME, TYPE, CODE, MENU_LEVEL, SUB_COUNT, PERMS, URL_TYPE, URL, ICON, POP_POSITION, IMAGE_PATH, CSS, JS_EVENT, MENU_SEQ, SHORT_CUT, IS_LEAF, IS_DISPLAY, IS_PROTECT, IS_DISABLED, IS_CHECK, PRIORITY, CREATOR_ID, CREATE_TIME, LAST_TIME, DEL_FLAG, DELETE_TIME, DESCRIPTION, SPARE1, SPARE2 ) VALUES ( #{item.id},#{item.parentId}, #{appId}, #{item.name}, #{item.sname}, #{item.ename}, #{item.type}, #{item.code}, #{item.menuLevel}, #{item.subCount}, #{item.perms}, #{item.urlType}, #{item.url}, #{item.icon}, #{item.popPosition}, #{item.imagePath}, #{item.css}, #{item.jsEvent}, #{item.menuSeq}, #{item.shortCut}, #{item.isLeaf}, #{item.isDisplay}, #{item.isProtect}, #{item.isDisabled}, #{item.isCheck}, #{item.priority}, #{item.creatorId}, #{item.createTime}, NULL, #{item.delFlag}, #{item.deleteTime}, #{item.description}, #{item.spare1}, #{item.spare2} )

SELECT t.MENU_ID||'' AS id,
IFNULL(t.PARENT_ID||'',t.APP_ID)
NVL(t.PARENT_ID||'',t.APP_ID)
AS parentId, t.name, t.APP_ID FROM SYS_ROLE_MENU rm, SYS_ROLE r, SYS_MENU t WHERE 1 = 1
AND rm.ROLE_ID in
#{roleId}
AND r.ROLE_ID = rm.ROLE_ID AND rm.MENU_ID = t.MENU_ID UNION ALL SELECT distinct t.APP_ID AS id,null AS parentId,a.name,t.APP_ID FROM SYS_ROLE_MENU rm, SYS_ROLE r, SYS_MENU t ,BASE_APP a WHERE 1 = 1
AND rm.ROLE_ID in
#{roleId}
AND r.ROLE_ID = rm.ROLE_ID AND rm.MENU_ID = t.MENU_ID AND t.APP_ID = t.APP_ID ORDER BY id
